blocks.heading: What a citizen’s manual covers
paragraphs: Under the Licensing Facilitation Act B.E. 2558 (2015), each manual must state the following information.

list.title: Criteria, methods and conditions
list.text: The criteria, methods and conditions for submitting a request.

list.title: Review procedure
list.text: Each step from submitting the request to notification of the permit decision.

list.title: Processing time
list.text: The time taken to consider the permit at each step.

list.title: Required documents
list.text: The documents or evidence to be submitted with the request.
